contents.text: What was Microsoft's current ratio (total current assets divided by total current liabilities) as of June 30, 2026, to two decimal places?

Microsoft's total current assets as of June 30, 2026, were $207,710 million, and its total current liabilities as of June 30, 2026, were $168,825 million. Therefore, Microsoft's current ratio as of June 30, 2026, was $207,710 million / $168,825 million, which equals 1.23. (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SUPPLEMENTARY DATA)
